entities.name: Dead Zone
entities.description: Portion of Ulgrotha with no mana, where living things are killed.

entities.name: Ravi
entities.description: Rang the Apocalypse Chime, completing the Great Destruction; brought back to the Dark Barony by Sengir.

entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: Chime rung by Ravi that completed the Great Destruction.

entities.name: Great Destruction
entities.description: Destruction begun by the Ancients and Tolgath, completed by Ravi.

entities.name: Tolgath
entities.description: Faction that dwelt in the Ulgrothan Citadel and battled the Ancients.

entities.name: Ulgrothan Citadel
entities.description: Home of the Tolgath, destroyed in their battle with the Ancients.

entities.name: Basalt Spire
entities.description: Ruined structure in the Dead Zone.

entities.name: Sengir
entities.description: Ventured into the Dead Zone and brought Ravi back to the Dark Barony.

events.summary: Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime and completes the Great Destruction, creating the Dead Zone.
events.quote: The Dead Zone was created when Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime and completed the Great Destruction begun by the Ancients and Tolgath .

events.summary: Sengir ventures far into the Dead Zone and brings Ravi back to the Dark Barony.
events.quote: Sengir must have been in possession of some sort of negating effect, as he was able to venture far into the Dead Zone and bring Ravi back to the Dark Barony .

relations.quote: The Dead Zone was a portion of Ulgrotha with no mana .
